To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
forced-air precool time did not influence quality attributes of Musa AAA berangan but influenced consumer acceptance.
the quality attributes and consumer acceptability of banana were not affected by the forced-air precoolings of 0, 50, or 120 min, but were affected by the forced precooling of 14 min.
forced-air precool time of 14 min did not affect banana quality, but 50- and 120-min precool time caused blackening on peel.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of forced-air pre-cooling on banana quality.
the effect of forced-air pre-cooling treatment on the quality attributes of banana.
the effect of different forced-air pre-cooling times on quality changes in banana and the influence of these changes on consumer acceptance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the optimum forced-air precool time of Musa AAA berangan should be between 14 and 50 min to maintain its quality attributes and consumer acceptability.
the forced-air precool treatment for 50 and/or 120 min did not affect quality parameters and sensory evaluation, except for peel colour.
a 14-min forced-air precool treatment is sufficient to preserve the quality attributes and consumer acceptability of Musa AAA Bananas.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the forced-air precoolings at 14 min were the optimum treatment to maintain the quality and consumer acceptance of the banana.
a forced-air precool treatment of 14 min was sufficient for Musa AAA Berangen to be precooled without causing any quality deterioration and consumer dissatisfaction.
a forced-air precool treatment of 14 min would be sufficient to maintain the quality of banana.
The main takeaway from our work is that
forced-air precool treatment for 14 min can be recommended to maintain the quality of banana during cold storage and transportation.
a 14-min forced-air precool treatment is adequate to reduce the postharvest losses of Musa AAA.
the application of forced-air pre-cooling for up to 14 min did not affect the quality attributes of Musa AAA.
